prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Mentra App miniapp uses Miniapp SDK:.
chosen: Build with @mentra/miniapp (registerMiniapp + session). Glasses connection, TTS/STT, and platform services come from the Mentra App host.
rejected: Always use @mentra/bluetooth-sdk even when the app runs inside the Mentra App as a miniapp.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Own mobile app → Bluetooth SDK:.
chosen: For a first-party Android/iOS/RN app that connects to Mentra Live over BLE, use the Mentra Bluetooth SDK and match glasses software to the SDK version.
rejected: Spin up a cloud @mentra/sdk AppServer; that is still the supported way to drive Mentra Live today.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Redirect legacy cloud docs:.
chosen: @mentra/sdk cloud apps are legacy. Current on-device path is @mentra/miniapp; older cloud docs live under mentraglass.com/legacy.
rejected: New Mentra apps should start from AppServer in @mentra/sdk with packageName and apiKey on a public server.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Background owns session; UI has no hardware:.
chosen: Background (@mentra/miniapp/background) always-on, owns session.* Hardware. UI is React WebView only; talk via mentra.* / session.ui.* typed channels. No DOM in background.
rejected: Import registerMiniapp into App.tsx and call session.display.render from the React tree.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Return setup promise; register UI handlers first:.
chosen: registerMiniapp(async (session) => { register session.ui.handle / onOpen first; return or await setup. Do not void the setup promise. Keep slow network out of startup. })
rejected: registerMiniapp((session) => { void loadEverything(); /* UI opens before handlers exist */ });

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Supported background globals only:.
chosen: Background is bare JS (no window/DOM/Node). Use console, timers, fetch, WebSocket, localStorage, crypto.getRandomValues/randomUUID, TextEncoder/Decoder. For elapsed time use Date.now() — not performance.now().
rejected: Use require("fs") and performance.now() in src/background/index.ts.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Read capabilities on ready:.
chosen: session.capabilities is null until ready. Subscribe immediately; read display size / canPosition inside session.on("ready", …) or onCapabilitiesChange.
rejected: At the top of registerMiniapp, assume session.capabilities.display.width is already set.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: render replaces the whole frame:.
chosen: session.display.render([...]) describes the full current frame. Stable id updates in place; omit an id to remove it; render([]) clears. Prefer boxes from session.capabilities.display when ready.
rejected: Call session.display.appendText each time; the host accumulates history behind the element id.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Design for 500×220:.
chosen: Design layouts for 500×220 so they fit positioning devices; G2 576×288 leaves margin. Check canPosition for G1/Z100 text fallback.
rejected: Always assume 576×288 positioned bitmaps; never check canPosition or provide a text-only variant.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Scaffold with Bun:.
chosen: bunx create-mentra-miniapp my-miniapp && bun install && bun dev. Load via Mentra App → Settings → Miniapp Developer Settings → Scan Miniapp QR (same Wi-Fi, or bun dev --usb on Android).
rejected: npx create-expo-app and load the miniapp in Expo Go; Mentra miniapps do not use Expo Go.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Three packages, one direct invoke:.
chosen: create-mentra-miniapp scaffolds once via bunx. @mentra/miniapp is the runtime dependency. @mentra/miniapp-cli provides mentra-miniapp dev/pack/release as a devDependency.
rejected: Add create-mentra-miniapp to dependencies and import it from application code.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Beta: no store distribution yet:.
chosen: Miniapp SDK is beta; MentraOS 3.0 has no Developer Console / Miniapp Store upload path yet. Local pack/install for testing only. For Mentra Live shipping apps prefer Bluetooth SDK.
rejected: Upload the miniapp to the Mentra Miniapp Store from the Developer Console in MentraOS 3.0.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: RN scan MentraLive then connect:.
chosen: import BluetoothSdk, { DeviceModels } from '@mentra/bluetooth-sdk'; const devices = await BluetoothSdk.scan(DeviceModels.MentraLive, { timeoutMs: 10000 }); await BluetoothSdk.connect(device);
rejected: In a standalone React Native app, call registerMiniapp and session.display.render without the Mentra App host.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Development build required:.
chosen: @mentra/bluetooth-sdk needs a development or production native build. Expo Go cannot load its native modules.
rejected: Install @mentra/bluetooth-sdk and test fully inside Expo Go.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Match SDK and glasses software:.
chosen: Bluetooth SDK and Mentra Live glasses software must share the same release (e.g. both 3.3.0). BLE connected ≠ version-compatible; update glasses before testing features.
rejected: Bluetooth connection alone confirms compatibility; skip Mentra Live software updates.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Documented imports only:.
chosen: Android: com.mentraglass:bluetooth-sdk. iOS/macOS: MentraBluetoothSDK. RN: @mentra/bluetooth-sdk (hooks from @mentra/bluetooth-sdk/react). Do not rely on underscore-prefixed internals.
rejected: Import @mentra/bluetooth-sdk/_internal and treat it as stable public API.

prompt: You are coaching MentraOS smart-glasses development (Miniapp SDK @mentra/miniapp and Bluetooth SDK). Produce the CORRECT guidance for: Tag Mentra trajectories mentra:.
chosen: Log Mentra Miniapp and Bluetooth coaching with metadata.domain = mentra via jarvis_log_outcome / feedback.
rejected: Use metadata.domain = python_jarvis for all Mentra TypeScript SDK work.

prompt: Should a Mentra App miniapp use @mentra/miniapp or @mentra/bluetooth-sdk?
chosen: Use @mentra/miniapp (registerMiniapp + session). The Mentra App host owns glasses connection and platform services.
rejected: Always use @mentra/bluetooth-sdk inside Mentra App miniapps.

prompt: I am building my own React Native app that talks to Mentra Live over Bluetooth. Which SDK?
chosen: Mentra Bluetooth SDK (@mentra/bluetooth-sdk) with a development/production native build. Match glasses software to the SDK version.
rejected: Use only @mentra/miniapp registerMiniapp; it works without the Mentra App host.

prompt: Is @mentra/sdk AppServer still the recommended way to build Mentra apps?
chosen: No. Cloud @mentra/sdk is legacy. Current on-device path is @mentra/miniapp; older docs are under mentraglass.com/legacy.
rejected: Yes. Scaffold a new cloud AppServer with packageName and apiKey for every Mentra Live app.

prompt: Where does session.display.render belong in a Mentra miniapp?
chosen: In the background layer (@mentra/miniapp/background) that owns session. The React UI has no direct hardware access.
rejected: Call session.display.render from App.tsx in the UI WebView.

prompt: Can the miniapp UI layer import Node fs or touch the DOM from background?
chosen: UI may use the DOM/React. Background has no DOM/Node; only supported globals (console, timers, fetch, WebSocket, localStorage, crypto RNG, TextEncoder/Decoder).
rejected: Put require('fs') and document.createElement in src/background/index.ts.

prompt: Why does registerMiniapp need to return its setup promise?
chosen: The Mentra App holds the splash and buffers UI messages until the handler promise settles. Returning setup ensures session.ui handlers exist before mentra.request.
rejected: Always void the setup promise so the UI opens immediately even if handlers are missing.

prompt: Order of work in registerMiniapp startup?
chosen: Register session.ui.handle / onOpen first; keep slow network out of the startup path; return or await local setup.
rejected: Await a long network refresh before registering any UI handlers.

prompt: When is session.capabilities populated?
chosen: After the connect handshake — typically inside session.on('ready', …). It is null when the handler first runs.
rejected: It is always set synchronously at the first line of registerMiniapp.

prompt: How do you unsubscribe from session.transcription.on?
chosen: Call the cleanup function returned by .on() / onButtonPress / etc. Subscriptions are ref-counted by the SDK.
rejected: There is no unsubscribe; leak handlers until the process exits.

prompt: What does session.display.render(elements) mean?
chosen: It replaces the whole HUD frame. Stable ids update in place; omitted ids are removed; render([]) clears the display.
rejected: It appends elements to a host-side history for that id.

prompt: Recommended canvas size when designing miniapp HUD layouts?
chosen: Design for 500×220 so layouts fit positioning devices; larger G2 canvas leaves margin. Use session.capabilities.display when ready for exact fit.
rejected: Always hardcode 1920×1080 phone pixels for the glasses HUD.

prompt: How should text-only miniapps treat G1 / Z100?
chosen: Render the same scene; phone degrades to text-only reading order. Check canPosition when layouts need images or precise boxes.
rejected: Crash if canPosition is false; refuse to render any text.

prompt: Clear the glasses HUD from a miniapp.
chosen: Call session.display.render([]).
rejected: Call session.display.clearForever() which is not the documented API.

prompt: Show Hello on button press in a miniapp background.
chosen: session.input.onButtonPress(() => session.display.render([{type:'text', id:'hud', box:{…}, text:'Hello from MentraOS'}]));
rejected: From the React UI, call BluetoothSdk.displayText without a Mentra App session.

prompt: Mirror live captions onto the glasses in a miniapp.
chosen: session.transcription.on((data) => session.display.render([{type:'text', id:'caption', box:…, text:data.text}]));
rejected: Poll a cloud WebSocket from @mentra/sdk and invent caption layout APIs.

prompt: How do I scaffold a Mentra miniapp?
chosen: bunx create-mentra-miniapp my-miniapp, then bun install and bun dev. Scan the QR from Mentra App Miniapp Developer Settings.
rejected: npx create-react-app and manually copy undocumented Mentra internals.

prompt: Phone and laptop on different Wi-Fi — Android USB option?
chosen: Run bun dev --usb so the CLI uses adb reverse and the QR points at the phone loopback.
rejected: There is no USB path; always require shared Wi-Fi even on Android.

prompt: What do create-mentra-miniapp, @mentra/miniapp, and @mentra/miniapp-cli each do?
chosen: Scaffolder via bunx once; @mentra/miniapp is the runtime; @mentra/miniapp-cli provides mentra-miniapp dev/pack/release as a devDependency.
rejected: Install create-mentra-miniapp as a runtime dependency and import it in background code.

prompt: Can I publish a Miniapp SDK build to the Mentra Miniapp Store on MentraOS 3.0?
chosen: No. Store/Developer Console distribution for Miniapp SDK is not available in MentraOS 3.0; local pack/install for testing only.
rejected: Yes. Upload through the Mentra Developer Console and users download from the store today.

prompt: React Native scan and connect to Mentra Live.
chosen: import BluetoothSdk, {DeviceModels} from '@mentra/bluetooth-sdk'; scan(DeviceModels.MentraLive); then connect(device).
rejected: Call registerMiniapp from a standalone RN app without the Mentra App host.

prompt: Does Expo Go support @mentra/bluetooth-sdk?
chosen: No. Expo Go cannot load the SDK native modules; use a development or production native build.
rejected: Yes. Expo Go includes Mentra Bluetooth native modules.

prompt: Bluetooth SDK 3.3.0 with older Mentra Live firmware — OK?
chosen: No. Match SDK and Mentra Live glasses software versions (e.g. both 3.3.0). BLE connected does not imply compatibility.
rejected: Any connected glasses firmware is fine; skip Mentra Live updates.

prompt: Android package for Mentra Bluetooth SDK?
chosen: com.mentraglass:bluetooth-sdk with import com.mentra.bluetoothsdk.*
rejected: com.google.android.glasses:mentra-legacy only.

prompt: iOS import for Mentra Bluetooth SDK?
chosen: Swift package MentraBluetoothSDK; import MentraBluetoothSDK.
rejected: import MentraCloudSDK from the legacy AppServer pod.

prompt: RN hooks entry for Mentra Bluetooth?
chosen: import {useMentraBluetooth} from '@mentra/bluetooth-sdk/react' (and related documented hooks).
rejected: import {useMentraBluetooth} from '@mentra/bluetooth-sdk/_internal/hooks'.

prompt: Show text on Mentra Live from Bluetooth SDK (RN).
chosen: Use documented APIs such as BluetoothSdk.displayText / clearDisplay after connect — not Miniapp session.display.render.
rejected: Call session.display.render from Bluetooth SDK without a Miniapp session.

prompt: Start an RTMP/SRT/WebRTC stream from Mentra Live via Bluetooth SDK.
chosen: After connect, use documented streaming commands (e.g. startStream / stopStream) with your ingest endpoint.
rejected: POST binary frames to api.mentra.glass REST without the Bluetooth SDK stream APIs.

prompt: How do miniapp UI and background communicate?
chosen: Declare typed Channels in shared/channels.ts. UI uses mentra.send/on/request; background uses session.ui.send/on/handle. No shared memory.
rejected: Share a global mutable object between UI and background bundles.

prompt: What if background sends session.ui.send while UI is closed?
chosen: It drops silently — no WebView receiver. UI mentra.send buffers until mentra.ready().
rejected: Background crashes if the UI is not open.

prompt: Where are miniapp entry points and hardware requirements declared?
chosen: miniapp.json — package identity, background/ui entries, permissions, and hardware requirements (e.g. DISPLAY).
rejected: Only in package.json scripts; miniapp.json is optional.

prompt: Does session.display.render require a special permission?
chosen: Display needs no permission, but declare DISPLAY hardware requirement so the miniapp only installs on glasses with a screen.
rejected: You must request CAMERA permission before any text HUD render.

prompt: Capture a photo on camera glasses from a miniapp.
chosen: Use session.camera APIs in the background after ready/capabilities show camera support; declare required hardware/permissions in miniapp.json.
rejected: Call navigator.mediaDevices from the background QuickJS context.

prompt: Raw mic audio vs transcription in Miniapp SDK?
chosen: session.transcription for speech-to-text; session.mic for raw chunks / VAD. Subscribe via .on and keep cleanup functions.
rejected: Only BluetoothSdk.setMicState works inside Mentra App miniapps.

prompt: Play TTS through Mentra miniapp speaker APIs.
chosen: Use session.speaker in the background for URLs, TTS, or PCM as documented.
rejected: Shell out to espeak from the background with child_process.

prompt: Should app developers call Mentra OEM engine.* APIs?
chosen: No for normal miniapps/mobile apps. OEM engine APIs are for glasses OEMs embedding MentraOS; app-dev surfaces are Miniapp or Bluetooth SDK.
rejected: Yes. Every miniapp should call engine.* pairing APIs directly.

prompt: What feedback metadata.domain should Mentra SDK trajectories use?
chosen: metadata.domain = mentra (Learning UI / few-shot slice). Log via jarvis_log_outcome after Mentra sessions.
rejected: metadata.domain = python_jarvis for all Mentra TypeScript work.

prompt: Where is the Mentra docs index for AI tools?
chosen: https://docs.mentraglass.com/llms.txt lists all pages; prefer those docs over inventing APIs.
rejected: Only scrape Discord; ignore docs.mentraglass.com.

prompt: Minimum Android SDK / iOS deployment for Mentra Bluetooth SDK?
chosen: Android min SDK 28+; iOS deployment target 15.1+; native macOS 13+ (RN-macos example 14+).
rejected: Android API 16 and iOS 9 are supported.

prompt: Physical device required for Bluetooth SDK testing?
chosen: Yes. Real Bluetooth testing needs a physical Android phone, iPhone, or Mac — not only a simulator without BLE.
rejected: iOS Simulator fully emulates Mentra Live BLE for production sign-off.

prompt: Miniapp background crash — what does the host do?
chosen: Host restarts background with backoff; in-flight UI requests may fail with BACKGROUND_RESTARTED and are not auto-replayed.
rejected: The Mentra App uninstalls the miniapp on first crash.

prompt: What must the miniapp UI call on boot?
chosen: mentra.ready() after mounting so the host flushes buffered background messages.
rejected: Nothing; skip mentra.ready() forever.

prompt: How can Mentra AI call into a miniapp?
chosen: Expose typed actions via session.actions so Mentra AI can invoke them (interop layer separate from UI channels).
rejected: Open an unauthenticated TCP port from the background for Mentra AI.

prompt: Persist string settings in a Mentra miniapp.
chosen: Use session.storage (and session.blob for binary) scoped to the miniapp; or localStorage in background within documented limits.
rejected: Write to /etc/mentra/global.json from the background.

prompt: Call my backend as the signed-in Mentra user from a miniapp.
chosen: Use session.auth for a miniapp-scoped backend token / authenticated fetch as documented.
rejected: Hard-code a shared user password in miniapp.json.
